market_summary: US markets fell sharply on November 16 with Nvidia leading declines ahead of earnings, closing down 4.1% and dragging the Nasdaq down 2.5% to 24,509, the S&P 500 down 1.9% to 7,416, and the Dow down 1.4% to 51,608. The Singapore stock market extended losses for a third straight day, with the Straits Times Index retreating to just above 5,180 points as technology and AI stocks face broad selling pressure. New US chip export restrictions and concerns over semiconductor demand are weighing on investor sentiment, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index down 5.3%.

items.headline: Nvidia Reports Q3 FY2027 Earnings Today After Market Close With Interim CEO
items.summary: <cite index="5-1">Nvidia reports on 17 November after the US close, with consensus pointing to roughly US$109 billion in revenue and adjusted earnings of US$2.47 per share</cite>. <cite index="6-2,6-4">CFO Colette Kress serves as interim CEO following Jensen Huang's departure from the CEO post and board on 12 November</cite>.

items.headline: Nvidia Directors Rule Out Huang's Return as Company Prepares to Report Earnings
items.summary: Nvidia's board has officially ruled out a comeback for founder and former CEO Jensen Huang as the company prepares to report earnings. <cite index="12-2,12-3">Nvidia shares closed down 4.1% on Monday to $156.10, their lowest settlement since June 2025, with shares declining nearly 35% since their early October peak</cite>.

items.headline: Broad Selloff in Technology and Semiconductor Stocks Ahead of Nvidia Earnings
items.summary: <cite index="14-1,14-3">United States equities fell sharply as a deep contraction in technology and semiconductor heavyweights dragged the major indices down, with the Nasdaq Composite sliding 2.4%, the S&P 500 shedding 1.9%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average plunging over 700 points</cite>.

items.headline: DBS and JPMorgan Launch 24/7 Tokenised Deposit Transfer Service
items.summary: <cite index="31-1">DBS and JPMorgan launched a 24/7 tokenized deposit transfer service connecting institutional accounts in Singapore and the United States</cite>. <cite index="28-3">The partnership connects DBS' tokenized deposit service with JPMorgan's blockchain-based payments unit Kinexys and allows customers to make transfers around the clock, including on weekends and outside normal banking hours</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines Group Passenger Traffic Rose 3.5% in October; Cargo Demand Strong
items.summary: <cite index="40-4,40-6">The Group's passenger traffic grew 3.5% year-on-year, outpacing a 2.9% expansion in capacity, while revenue passenger-kilometres increased 3.5% to 14,102.8 million</cite>. <cite index="40-7">The resulting PLF of 87.8% compares with 87.3% in October 2025</cite>. Cargo operations saw strong growth driven by semiconductor shipments.

items.headline: Singapore Market on Three-Day Losing Streak; Downside Pressure Expected
items.summary: <cite index="22-1,22-2">The Singapore stock market has moved lower in three straight sessions, retreating more than 100 points or 2 percent, with the Straits Times Index now sitting just above the 5,180-point plateau</cite>. <cite index="22-5,22-6">The global forecast for the Asian markets is weak, with heavy selling pressure again expected among the technology shares, although sinking oil prices may limit the downside</cite>.
